_doc: Observation Blocker (defender pool; research/gadgets.md §4.7). Three each; placed (not thrown) in 1 s (Y11S1); electronic. Its reach, picking it up again and its size are placeholders. One bullet destroys it (1 hp, Y8S2). Its barrier (M3): up to 5 m wide and 2.2 m tall (Y8S2), facing its placer's way, narrower where walls are closer; the attackers' drones and hacked cameras can't see through it, players can (Y8S2).
name: Observation Blocker
